title: coreopsis insularis
intro: Coreopsis insularis, commonly known as the island tickseed, is a flowering plant species native to the Hawaiian Islands. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine for various health benefits. The health benefits of Coreopsis insularis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
